title: Business days between two dates, skipping weekends and holidays
contract: Counts non-weekend days in the half-open range [start, end) that are not in holidays. Reversed arguments are swapped so the result is never negative; equal dates give zero. Null holidays is empty. A holiday on a weekend changes nothing. Null start or end throws IllegalArgumentException.
expectedValuesFrom: Computed independently in Python with datetime/weekday(), not by running Solution.
